tips_en: Start with Paper 2 (SCOPE), as it tackles a widely relevant problem—T2I prompt optimization—with an elegant semantic-span credit assignment idea yielding strong gains on counting and spatial tasks. Papers 1 and 2 share a methodological thread around refined credit assignment in policy-gradient RL: Waypoint-OPD uses temporal waypoints to gate endpoint policy-shift distillation, while SCOPE pools log-probability shifts within semantic spans—both correcting coarse, uniform update signals. Paper 3 (OmniCompass) is independent methodologically and best read afterward if you need an evaluation suite for omni-modal MLLMs.
tips_zh: 建议先阅读论文2（SCOPE），它解决了一个应用面很广的任务——文生图提示优化——通过语义片段级别的信用分配思路，在计数和空间任务上取得了显著提升。论文1和论文2在方法层面有一条共同的线索：都围绕策略梯度中信用分配的精细化展开，前者通过时间路标检查点对端点策略漂移蒸馏进行门控，后者则在语义片段内汇聚对数概率漂移，二者都在纠正粗粒度、统一的更新信号。论文3（OmniCompass）在方法上相对独立，若需要一个全模态多模态大模型的评测基准，可作为后续阅读。
